clip.note: The brief asks for hook-first 30-40 s shorts (up to 50 s); the clipping course says short and powerful beats long. The hard window is what the platform tolerates, the preferred band is what we aim at, and leaving the band is a warning that has to be answered in the pack, not a silent choice.

hook.note: Hook strength is scored 0-10 on the first 2 s by scripts/whop/hook_lab.py, calibrated on this campaign's reference clips (defiance 8.0, number 6.0, setup-first 0.6). Floor 4.0 = at least one concrete element (number, contrast, stakes, curiosity) before the preamble can eat it.

ending.note: The course: cut at the emotional peak so the viewer taps before scrolling. The tail is the distance from the last spoken word to the end of the file; a CTA card plus fade over 2 s is a deliberate exception and must be recorded in the pack.
